indicios_detectados.description: one terse line: which receipt-like markers you found (date, amount, items, emitter, CUIT, words like 'factura'/'ticket'/'comprobante') or which are missing. Not a verdict yet, just the evidence

comprobante_valido.description: 'true' when the text is a receipt, 'false' when it is not. A damaged or partly illegible receipt is still 'true': reading quality is the base step's question, not this one's

motivo_rechazo.description: a short phrase naming why the document was refused, only when `comprobante_valido` is 'false'; otherwise 'null'
